name: bOnline
summary: UK business phone provider for small businesses: a VoIP number on your mobile app or desk phone, unlimited UK calling, call recording, call queues and IVR, and AI transcription and call summaries on its top plan.
best_for: UK sole traders and small businesses of one to a few people who want a business number on their mobile, a desk phone if needed, and unlimited UK calls for under £14 a user a month
skip_if: you need numbers and calling outside the UK as your main use; you will not sign anything before the contract term is in writing; or a team of agents needs a full contact-centre setup rather than a small-business phone line
honest_knock: bOnline does not put its contract length on the pricing page: the trial needs no card or commitment, but its own testimonials talk about renewing a contract after twelve months, so ask before you port your number. Starter at £7 a user includes only 100 outbound landline minutes a month, the 'unlimited' calls on the next plan carry an asterisk and a separate fair use policy we could not read, and all prices exclude VAT. It is built for UK numbers and UK calls; international minutes are bundles on top. The reviews on the pricing page are chosen by bOnline, and the 50,000-business figure is its own claim. We have not used bOnline ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per user a month plus VAT
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-06 on bonline.com/pricing, prices in GBP excluding VAT) Three plans, priced per user a month. Starter is £7.00 and gives a digital phone line and number, unlimited inbound calls, 100 outbound landline minutes and 40+ VoIP features. Unlimited Calling is £13.95 and adds unlimited UK landline and mobile calls (marked with an asterisk, and bOnline publishes a separate fair use policy), on-demand call recording and 45+ features. AI For Business Calls is £19.95, shown against a struck-through £21.95, and records every call, stores it for a year, and transcribes, summarises, scores and indexes it with AI. Add-ons are billed monthly: AI call recording £8, CRM integrations £8 (HubSpot, Zoho, Odoo, Pipedrive, Salesforce and 200 more), and international bundles at £6 for 500 minutes to 100 destinations, £10 for 1,000 minutes, or £5 for unlimited minutes to 14 destinations. The page offers a free trial with no card and no commitment, a price match guarantee and a 14-day 'love it' guarantee, and bOnline offers to cover up to £100 of exit fees from a previous provider. The pricing page does not state a contract length.

compare_with.name: CallHippo
compare_with.why: CallHippo is in our dossiers too, as a cloud phone system for small teams that prices per user like bOnline. On our 15 September 2026 reading, CallHippo Starter was $19 per user a month billed annually with a two-user minimum, or $25 month to month, with 1,000 US and Canadian minutes and 100 SMS. bOnline starts lower and is built for the UK: £7 a user excluding VAT with unlimited inbound but only 100 outbound landline minutes, or £13.95 for unlimited UK landline and mobile calls, with no stated user minimum. A UK business calling UK customers will usually pay less on bOnline; a team calling North America, or one that needs SMS on the entry plan, is closer to CallHippo's design.
